title: pollia sorzogonensis
intro: Pollia sorzogonensis, commonly known as the "miracle flower," is a type of flowering plant found in the Philippines. This plant is known for its unique ability to retain its glossy appearance and stay fresh for years, even when dried. The health benefits of Pollia sorzogonensis include its potential to improve digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have shown to have antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
